```plato

    // One level of Butterfly subdivision: the same 1-to-4 topology, the old
    // vertices left exactly where they are, and the eight-point stencil deciding
    // each new one. Interpolating, so the input mesh's vertices lie on the result.
    ButterflySubdivided(self: TriangleMesh3D): TriangleMesh3D
    {
        var topology = self.TopologyOf;
        var refined = self.SplitEdges(topology, AllEdgesMask(topology));
        var inserted = topology.EdgeCount.MapRange(e => self.ButterflyEdgePoint(topology, e));
        return (self.Positions.Concatenate(inserted), refined.Faces);
    }
```
